nodes.short_description: Испытайте скоростные гонки в футуристическом мире! Управляйте мощными дронами в неоновых туннелях. Собирайте атомы и избегайте преград.

nodes.short_description: Fütüristik bir dünyada yüksek hızlı yarışı deneyimleyin! Güçlü dronları kontrol edin ve neon tünellerde ilerleyin. Atomları toplayın ve engellerden kaçın.

nodes.short_description: ¡Vive carreras de alta velocidad en un mundo futurista! Pilotea drones potentes por túneles de neón. Recolecta átomos y esquiva obstáculos en VR.

nodes.long_description: Gå in i rutnätet och tävla om äran! Styr avancerade racingdrönare i cyberpunk-tunnlar. Innehåller: Snabba drönarlopp och fängslande VR-grafik.
nodes.short_description: Upplev höghastighetsracing i en futuristisk värld! Styr kraftfulla drönare genom neontunnlar. Samla atomer och undvik hinder i VR.

nodes.long_description:
Enter the Grid and Race for Glory!

Step into the cockpit of the future with VR Atomic Speed Racer. This high-octane VR experience puts you in control of advanced racing drones as you fly through a stunning, cyberpunk-themed tunnel at breakneck speeds. With every second, the intensity rises—do you have the reflexes to handle the heat?

Game Features:
Fast-Paced Drone Racing: Take charge of unique futuristic drones, including the 4V8 Gemini, and master the art of high-speed navigation.

Collect and Power Up: Fly through glowing atoms to increase your score and keep your fuel levels high as you push for a new record.

Dodge Lethal Obstacles: Stay alert to avoid giant energy shields and barriers that can end your race in an instant.

Immersive VR Graphics: Race through a vibrant neon-lit environment with detailed textures and immersive sound effects that make you feel the speed.

Track Your Progress: Review your stats on the scoreboard, including top speed, atoms collected, and close calls, to constantly improve your racing skills.

Buckle up, pilot. The tunnel is waiting, and the race of a lifetime starts now!
nodes.short_description: Experience high-speed racing in a futuristic world! In VR Atomic Speed Racer, take control of powerful drones and speed through glowing neon tunnels. Collect atoms to boost your score while dodging dangerous energy shields and obstacles. Can you survive the high-velocity challenge and become the top racer?

nodes.long_description: Betreten Sie das Grid und fahren Sie um den Sieg! Steuern Sie Renndrohnen in Cyberpunk-Tunneln. Features: Schnelle Drohnen-Action und immersive VR-Grafik.
nodes.short_description: Erleben Sie Hochgeschwindigkeitsrennen in einer futuristischen Welt! Steuern Sie Drohnen durch Neon-Tunnel. Sammeln Sie Atome und weichen Sie Hindernissen aus.

nodes.long_description: Tiến vào Grid và đua vì vinh quang! Điều khiển drone đua tiên tiến trong hầm cyberpunk. Đặc điểm: Đua drone tốc độ cao và đồ họa VR sống động.
nodes.short_description: Trải nghiệm đua xe tốc độ cao trong thế giới tương lai! Điều khiển drone qua hầm neon. Thu thập nguyên tử và tránh vật cản trong VR.

nodes.long_description: グリッドに入り、栄光を目指してレース！サイバーパンクなトンネルでドローンを操縦。特徴：ハイスピードなドローンレースと没入感のあるVRグラフィック。
nodes.short_description: 未来の世界で高速レースを体験！強力なドローンを操作してネオンのトンネルを駆け抜けよう。アトムを集めて障害物を回避。
